Overall sign height about 1.5 adult heights; board width about 0.9H. Light from screen upper left, right faces darker. Square transparent canvas, whole sign centered with generous 12% transparent padding all sides, complete feet visible. Real RGBA transparency, no background, no earth tile, no diamond platform, no cast shadow except tiny contact AO at feet. No people, house, road, typography, letters, numerals, text, watermarks, black cartoon stroke, modern material, extra floating icon, duplicate sign, mirrored lighting. Keep the construction compact and pictogram simple, no decorative clutter.
